evidence.clause_text: C4. Claimed amount must match the receipt: The amount claimed must equal the total printed on the receipt. A claim for more than the receipt total is rejected. A claim for less than the receipt total is acceptable (the claimant may choose not to claim some items).

verified_issues.message: The claim is for 2 units of Kopi Susu Kolonel but the receipt shows only 1, so the extra unit cannot be reimbursed under C9.

evidence.clause_text: C9. Quantities: The quantity of any item claimed must not exceed the quantity shown on the receipt, and the same receipt may not be claimed twice.

verified_issues.message: The unit price of IDR 23,000 is above the agreed maximum of IDR 20,000 for this item on the price list, so only IDR 20,000 per unit can be supported without review.

claims.draft:
Dear Member 001,

Claim VAL-001 cannot be paid as submitted, so it has been rejected.

- Amount: you claimed IDR 46,000, but the receipt total is IDR 23,000. Under C4, a claim for more than the receipt total is rejected.
- Quantity: you claimed 2 x Kopi Susu Kolonel, but the receipt shows 1. Under C9, the quantity claimed must not exceed the receipt, so only 1 can be claimed.
- Price: the unit price on the receipt is IDR 23,000, above the agreed maximum of IDR 20,000 on the price list. Only IDR 20,000 per unit can be supported without review.

To fix this, please resubmit the claim for one Kopi Susu Kolonel at no more than IDR 20,000. If you want the full IDR 23,000 considered, please ask for a review of the price.
